comment: Curated blurbs for the featured project cards. Live numbers (stars, forks, language) are merged in from data/github.json at build time by scripts/build.mjs.

projects.title: WSL Manager
projects.blurb: A Flutter/Dart GUI for managing WSL2 environments. 62+ releases shipped through the Microsoft Store, Winget, Scoop and Chocolatey, backed by a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and localized into 9 languages. Includes a built-in MCP server exposing WSL environments to AI agents such as Claude Desktop, remote management over SSH, and running Docker images as WSL instances without a Docker installation.

projects.title: Telegram & Signal Support Bot
projects.blurb: A TypeScript ticketing system with Docker deployment, Jest test coverage and SonarQube analysis, including optional LLM-based auto-responses. Survived several major migrations — including a full bot framework replacement — while preserving backward compatibility for existing deployments. Also operated as a hosted commercial service.

projects.title: PowerToys Run Winget Plugin
projects.blurb: A C# plugin for Microsoft PowerToys enabling package search and installation straight from the PowerToys Run launcher.
